lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five parallel horizontal rows extending from the posterior gill margin toward the caudal region, with higher spatial frequency in the anterior-mid flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct grid-like pattern of luminance maxima across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin's macro-mask.
